scoring_justification: Full MD simulation and energy minimization cannot be rerun in the verifier sandbox; compare reported quantities to paper's published values with tolerances derived from the paper's own uncertainties and expected implementation variations.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for melting temperatures (MOM and PRC1 models)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Section 4.3 states melting temperatures 116±3 K for MOM and 122±3 K for PRC1. The central values 116 K and 122 K are used.
hidden_assets.generation_method: directly copied from the paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published numbers; they serve as the reference standard.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for minimum-energy incommensurate herringbone structures (Table 4)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 4: Minimum-energy monolayer structures. Values for MOM and PRC1 models (a, b, α_cell, β1, β2, z, θ, V/N) are taken directly from the table.
hidden_assets.generation_method: directly copied from Table 4 of the paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed minimum-energy parameters; they are the reference target for this reproduction.

outputs.description: Estimated melting temperatures of the submonolayer herringbone solid for MOM and PRC1 models as obtained from MD simulations.
Minimum-energy incommensurate herringbone structures: unit-cell parameters, molecular orientations, height, coverage, and potential energy per molecule for MOM and PRC1.

output_contract.notes: Tolerances for each parameter will be applied individually; the hidden gold is the paper's reported values. The MD melting temperature scoring allows a ±6 K window to account for statistical and implementation differences.
